summary: This is an excerpt from a fiction work titled "Book 4 — part 47." Lucy reunites with Anda in an online game, where Anda has been promoted to Sergeant. The two miss the high-stakes campaigning they did before and talk with Raymond, who wants factory workers in Ciudad Juarez and Tijuana to walk out and organize. Anda proposes that they act as the girls' bodyguards in an in-game factory, where they plan to fight the bosses' mercenaries.
one_line: Lucy and Anda reunite in an online game and join Raymond's effort to organize factory workers in Ciudad Juarez and Tijuana.
key_facts: Anda has been promoted to Sergeant during her absence from the game.
Lucy says Anda earned the promotion and that the two are now the same rank.
Lucy has been talking with Raymond a lot about working conditions in the factory.
Anda says she misses the earlier campaigning, which was big fights with big stakes, while the game's standard missions feel pale and flat.
The worthy adversaries they enjoyed beating were people gaming the game for money, and beating them involved no guilt.
Raymond wants the workers to go on strike, saying the only way to get results is to band together and withdraw labour.
Raymond wants the walkout to happen in Ciudad Juarez and Tijuana, not in-game, and plans to call the press in.
Raymond says the organizing problem is that the bosses lock the doors and keep organizers out of sewing shops and toy factories.
Raymond says the parents of the girls will not let organizers talk to them.
Raymond says he keeps getting killed in the game while trying to reach the girls.
Anda proposes that she and Lucy act as Raymond's new bodyguards in an in-game factory.
Anda notes that the bosses hire mean mercenaries, and she once was one of them.
Raymond's character plants a kiss on Anda's cheek, and Anda's character shoves him sprawling.
Anda asks Lucy to go get a couple of BFGs.
